subject: forklift
label: forklift.mdl, in the place of the game's models/forklift.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/sat_globe.mdl, models/fungus.mdl, models/bm_leg.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 3 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked B, B, B where the asset was C, C, A: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: The outline is a plain rectangular block in all ten views (sides.png: front, left, back, right and top each show one rectangle; the four angled views show one box). A forklift's outline is missing entirely: no mast or uprights, no forks, no overhead guard, no seat, no wheels showing below the body. The brief's silhouette is not there in any view.

M2.reason: Measured size is 186.6 long, 60 wide and 113.4 high against the brief's 187, 60 and 113, with a size offset of 0.003. Each dimension is well within 15%.

M3.reason: The brief asks for a forklift with its driver in the seat. Listing the parts down to the small ones: mast with two uprights, two forks, overhead guard with posts, seat, driver, steering wheel, counterweight, four wheels and tyres, backrest, lift carriage. None of them is in the asset (sides.png shows one solid box in every view). Parts absent: all of them, so the driver, seat, mast, forks and wheels are all missing.

M4.reason: The whole asset is one flat mid-grey painted surface with faint grain (lineup.png, C; sides.png, every view). The grey reads as painted metal, but the forklift's regions are absent: no body colour distinct from the frame, no tyre rubber, no seat cloth, no driver's skin or clothing. Clearly off for the regions the brief names.

M5.reason: The surface carries only uniform grain and light edge highlights (sides.png, left and top views). No panel lines, lettering, safety striping, grille, lamp or wear is there, though a warehouse forklift would carry some of these. Clearly thinner than the brief implies.

M6.reason: Capped by the line-up test, as the rubric sets for this judging: the asset was shown among four models (lineup.png, C beside sat_globe, fungus and bm_leg), and the line-up test picked B, B, B, a Valve model, as the one not made by Valve, so the asset passed as one of the game's on that test. This score comes from that test, not from my own look at the box.

M7.reason: The asset stands upright on its base (front, back, left and right views all show it resting on the bottom edge). It has no front to speak of: the box is symmetrical, with no forks, mast or seat to say which side the front is, so the brief's facing cannot be read.

M8.reason: The checkErrors list is empty, so SMAK's GoldSrc check passes. It has 12 triangles, far under twice the median of Half-Life's props of this size. The box is closed: the below view and the four angled views show no open or inside-out faces, and nothing floats.
